items.title: Libtt: A Compiler and Runtime for Tenstorrent Processors
items.author: Philipp Moritz, Sarah Dong
items.snippet: Libtt brings the PyTorch and JAX ecosystem to Tenstorrent hardware. It implements PJRT, the interface through which XLA-based frameworks drive Google's TPUs, so JAX runs on it directly, PyTorch runs through TorchTPU, and software written for TPUs carries over with no changes…
